title: What the Last Page Said
summary: The librarian has finished studying the Warden Journal you trusted her with. She found something on the last page the cult missed: where the Chariot's armour was forged.

quest_book.title: The Last Page
quest_book.author: The Librarian
pages:
You let me keep the journal. I've barely slept.

The last page isn't a prayer. It's a smith's note.
Come and see me. I've made you something from it.

threats.name: The Librarian
threats.target_line: I haven't slept in three days. You have to see this.
talk: A recipe. Not for a weapon. For a ward. The god's fire can't cross it.
I already did. Take these. And thank you for trusting me with it.
